cases.title: Version derivation and VERSIONINFO for release, dev and test identities
cases.precondition: Clean checkout at the stage commit; tags v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 in a temporary repository fixture.
steps: Derive versions for release, dev and test identities from the tag fixture and a fixed UTC build time.
Build delta.exe with DELTA_VERSION injected and read --build-info and the PE VERSIONINFO.
Attempt a build with an invalid tag and with a version lower than the latest tag.
cases.expected: Release is 0.1.N from the tag, dev and test are <next>-dev.<UTC>; build-info, VERSIONINFO and the About page agree; invalid or downgraded versions fail the build.

cases.title: Single instance and control pipe per channel
cases.precondition: Test identity build; isolated data root; hidden window.
steps: Start the test identity app, then start it again.
Send focus and quit-for-update over the channel pipe while a note autosave is pending.
Connect using another identity pipe name, and send quit-for-update while a sync job runs.
cases.expected: The second start only signals the first; quit-for-update waits for the save and exits with a receipt; busy returns busy without exiting; cross-channel commands are rejected.

cases.title: Inno Setup per-user silent install and uninstall of the test identity (M3-K01)
cases.precondition: Pinned Inno Setup 7.1.x present; test identity setup.exe built; developer delta/delta-dev installs untouched.
steps: Run setup.exe /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART for delta-test and delta-dev-test.
Check install directories, Start menu shortcut, HKCU uninstall keys and the installed --build-info.
Run the installed --ui-smoke, then uninstall silently.
cases.expected: No UAC prompt and no visible window; both test identities coexist; files and uninstall keys are removed on uninstall while the data roots and an unknown file in them remain; developer installs are byte-identical before and after.

cases.title: In-place upgrade preserves data and never kills a running app
cases.precondition: Test identity v1 installed with an AC-02 library, a note and an attachment.
steps: Run the app hidden, then install v2 with the installer while it runs.
Repeat with quit-for-update answering busy and with an app that never exits within 30 s.
cases.expected: The installer waits for a saved exit and upgrades; library, notes, attachments and settings are unchanged; a busy or stuck app is never force-killed and the installation stays at v1 with a reported reason.

cases.title: M2 portable installation migration
cases.precondition: Test identity installed with the M2 package-install layout plus one modified and one unknown file.
steps: Run the M3 test identity setup.exe over the M2 layout.
cases.expected: Manifest files with matching hashes and the two manifests are removed before the new files are copied; modified manifest files are kept renamed to <name>.m2-modified and unknown files are kept untouched; both are listed in the setup log; the app starts from the new installation and uninstalling it leaves the kept files.

cases.title: install-dev updates only the dev channel
cases.precondition: Dev-test identity used in place of delta-dev through the command test hook; a release-identity and an older package are also available.
steps: Run install-dev with a running dev-test app and a newer package.
Run install-dev with a release package and with a package older than the installed version.
cases.expected: The running app saves and exits, the package installs silently, the installed version matches, and the app restarts because it was running; release packages and downgrades are refused without changes.

cases.title: Update signature, downgrade and transport policy
cases.precondition: Unit fixtures with a test Ed25519 key pair; release identity policy and test identity policy.
steps: Verify valid, tampered, missing, cross-version and cross-channel signatures.
Offer equal and lower versions.
Offer http://, a non-allowlisted redirect host, a size above 512 MiB and a SHA-256 mismatch.
cases.expected: Only the valid signature for a higher version over HTTPS from allowlisted hosts is accepted; every other case is rejected with a specific reason; loopback HTTP is accepted only by the test identity policy.

cases.title: Loopback online update rehearsal (M3-K03)
cases.precondition: 127.0.0.1 HTTP release source serving latest.json, setup.exe and .sig signed by a test key; test identity v1 installed with data.
steps: Check for updates, interrupt the download once and resume with Range.
Confirm the update while idle and once while a sync job is busy.
cases.expected: The busy case asks and does nothing without confirmation; the idle case makes a consistent backup, re-verifies the signature, installs silently, restarts, reports the new version and keeps all data; the backup restores.

cases.title: release-build produces signed artifacts and refuses without a key
cases.precondition: Test signing key in a test credential namespace; no real release key.
steps: Run release-build for a test version with the key, then without it.
cases.expected: setup.exe, latest.json and .sig are consistent and verify with the matching public key; PE imports have no MSVC runtime; without a key the command fails and leaves no publishable artifacts; the private key never appears in logs.

cases.title: M3 gate quietness and isolation (M3-K04) plus M2/M1 regression
cases.precondition: Full M3 gate with --installer --ui-smoke on the final source fingerprint.
steps: Run verify-stage --stage M3 --plan-version 1.0 --installer --ui-smoke.
Run verify-stage --stage M2 --plan-version 1.0 and --stage M1 --plan-version 2.6.
cases.expected: Below-normal priority, zero visible windows, foreground unchanged, developer delta/delta-dev installs and data roots untouched, test roots removed; M2 and M1 regressions pass.

cases.title: Clean machine installation of both channels (H-03)
cases.precondition: Clean Windows VM or Windows Sandbox without Rust/MSVC/Python or VC++ redistributables; the two setup.exe from the stage report.
steps: Install DELTA and DELTA Dev without administrator rights, run both offline, check Start menu and Apps & features.
Uninstall DELTA Dev from Apps & features.
cases.expected: Both install and run side by side; SmartScreen behaviour recorded; uninstalling one channel keeps the other and both data roots.

cases.title: Release update experience (H-04)
cases.precondition: Release-channel test build pointed at the loopback source of the stage report rehearsal.
steps: Observe the update-ready badge, the settings update page, the busy confirmation and the restart.
cases.expected: Wording, timing and the restart are clear; no data loss; the user can disable automatic checks.

cases.title: First public release v0.1.1 on GitHub (ACT-11)
cases.precondition: User authorization ACT-11 and the backed-up signing key ACT-10.
steps: Create tag v0.1.1 and the GitHub Release with setup.exe, latest.json and .sig.
Let an installed release build check for updates against the real source.
cases.expected: The real source returns the signed release and the client verifies it; until authorized this case stays not-run.
